limitations.note: The patch fixed the counter handshake but also removed the downstream-ready condition for starting a new sum, changing what gets accumulated when the first input is accepted with `ready_b` low.
The scoreboard assumed every group starts from zero regardless of `ready_b`, so it validated the new accumulator behavior rather than detecting the difference from the original behavior.

limitations.quote: rm -f style commands are not permitted
limitations.note: Putting the cleanup trap in the test command caused the tool to reject the entire invocation before simulation, forcing the agent to resubmit the test setup with different cleanup.
